trace.purpose: Find model_year and powertrain combination with highest average warranty cost per vehicle delivered

WITH cost_per_vehicle AS (
  SELECT
    v.model_year,
    v.powertrain,
    SUM(COALESCE(w.cost_eur, 0)) AS total_warranty_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS vehicle_count
  FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
  LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w ON v.vin = w.vin
  GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
)
SELECT
  model_year,
  powertrain,
  total_warranty_cost / vehicle_count AS avg_cost_per_vehicle
FROM cost_per_vehicle
ORDER BY avg_cost_per_vehicle DESC
